name: Gorfin Hall
summary: A modern community hall in a quiet corner of town.
description: Run by Exmouth Town Council, Gorfin Hall is a modern, adaptable community centre a short walk from the town centre. It is booked out for all sorts through the week — keep-fit classes, art groups, talks and lectures — and at weekends works well for children's parties or a family celebration, with a kitchenette on hand for refreshments.
